coursePayments.title: Course payments
coursePayments.subtitle: Learners' manual course payments across every academy. Approving one gives the learner access to the course.
coursePayments.detailSubtitle: Check the proof, then approve or reject this course payment.
coursePayments.emptyDescription: Course payments matching this filter will appear here.
coursePayments.noProof: The learner hasn't uploaded proof of payment yet.
coursePayments.proofLoadError: The proof file couldn't be opened. Try again.
coursePayments.alreadyReviewed: This payment has already been reviewed and can no longer be approved or rejected.

confirmApprove.title: Approve this course payment?
confirmApprove.description: You confirm that {{amount}} was received. The learner gets access to the course immediately. This can't be undone.

confirmReject.title: Reject this course payment?
confirmReject.description: The {{amount}} payment will be marked as rejected and the learner will see your reason. This can't be undone.

coursePayments.approvedToast: Payment approved. The learner now has access to the course.
coursePayments.rejectedToast: Payment rejected. The learner has been told why.

payouts.title: Academy payouts
payouts.subtitle: What Atlas has recorded as owed to, or paid to, each academy from course sales.
payouts.emptyDescription: Create a payout to record what an academy is owed for a period.

create.title: Create payout
create.description: Atlas calculates the amount from the academy's unsettled course revenue in this period. One payout is created per currency.
create.periodHint: Dates are in UTC and include the whole of the last day.
create.nothingOwed: Nothing to pay out: this academy has no unsettled revenue in this period.

markPaid.title: Mark this payout as paid?
markPaid.description: You confirm that {{amount}} has been sent to the academy. This can't be undone.

commission.title: Commission
commission.subtitle: What Atlas keeps from each course sale collected through Atlas Payments.
commission.hierarchyDescription: An organization's own setting wins, then its plan's rate, then the global default. Changes apply to new payments only — each payment keeps the rate it was created with. Organization settings are on each organization's page.
commission.percentHint: Between 0 and 100, up to two decimal places.

global.title: Global default
global.unsetNotice: No global default is set. Organizations without a plan or organization rate have no commission until you set one. Once set, the default can be changed but not removed.
global.confirmDescription: The default changes from {{from}} to {{to}}. It applies to new course payments of every organization without its own or a plan rate.

plans.title: Plan rates
plans.subtitle: Overrides the global default for organizations on a plan. A plan rate can be changed but not removed.
plans.dialogDescription: Applies to new course payments of organizations on this plan, unless the organization has its own setting.

organization.title: Commission
organization.unresolved: No commission applies: no organization, plan or global rate is set.

default.label: Use plan or global rate
default.hint: No override. The plan's rate applies, or the global default.

custom.label: Custom rate
custom.hint: A specific rate for this organization only.

exempt.label: Exempt
exempt.hint: Atlas keeps no commission from this organization's course sales.

confirmDescription.default: This organization will use its plan's rate or the global default for new course payments.
confirmDescription.custom: This organization will pay {{rate}} commission on new course payments.
confirmDescription.exempt: Atlas will keep no commission from this organization's new course payments.

validation.notesTooLong: Notes must be 1000 characters or fewer.
validation.rejectNotesTooShort: Give the learner a reason of at least 10 characters.
validation.periodEndAfterStart: The end date must be after the start date.
validation.referenceTooLong: The reference must be 255 characters or fewer.
validation.percentFormat: Enter a number with up to two decimal places, like 12.5.
